set -e
git mv app/composables/useCart.ts app/composables/useShoppingCart.ts
files=$(grep -rl "useCart\b" app | grep -v useCartTotal || true)

for f in $files; do

done
sed -i '' -e 's#export function useCart()#export function useShoppingCart()#' -e "s#^/\*\* The cart, persisted#/** The cart, persisted#" app/composables/useShoppingCart.ts
grep -rn "useCart\b\|useShoppingCart\|composables/useCart'" app
